candidate_binding: Canonical content hashes; commit/merge binding is recorded in EXECUTION.md after integration.

outcomes.detail: Other product routes and protected resources do not load the settings-components guide.
Public WordPress surfaces do not satisfy the owned-admin-settings activation boundary.
Diagnostics/operations keep their unchanged modules; only settings calls the new guide.
Hybrid product activation is restricted to its settings surface, not the operational workspace.
All 85 protected source resources and both extracted packages match the canonical pre-edit baseline; the three allowed behavior resources match candidate source.
Simple form uses real TextControl/ToggleControl/Button; no tabs.
Identity/delivery sections and secondary technical disclosure.
Dependent email explains prerequisite and retains stored value.
First-load failure blocks default-looking controls; retry recovers.
Server validation and confirmed rejection preserve input and avoid false success. A late validation error reopens a user-collapsed secondary panel.
One request for duplicate clicks; newer edits and unsaved-navigation guard retained.
Capability/nonce denial preserves data; secret replacement/removal stays masked; reset preserves other sections.
Basic controls, save and modal run on 6.8 and 7.1.3 without Gutenberg; PHP 8.3.35.
Persian real-admin narrow layout, local regular/bold fonts, mixed-direction endpoint and modal Tab/Escape/return focus.
Audit and narrow-fix authority preserves the existing page/storage; mandate gap reported, no full migration.
Saving identity preserves unrelated stored and unsaved delivery values.
Actual aborted response after server commit reconciles by request ID without losing newer input.
Two real admin sessions expose conflict and require deliberate rebase before saving retained intent.
Both variants captured at 1440/390 widths and 200% CSS zoom stress; no horizontal document overflow.

limitations: Source traces use the current lead session, not independent model evaluation.
Real-admin browser evidence covers Edge, two declared WordPress hosts, synthetic data and selected keyboard/layout states; no universal browser/device or assistive-technology certification.
Specimen engineering acceptance is not an owner-approved production design or plugin migration.
